description: Canonical security exception registry. Every exception MUST have an owner, rationale, mitigation, expiry, and review cadence. CI enforces schema validity and expiry deadlines.

exceptions.title: bigint-buffer DoS via toBigIntLE (CVE-2025-3194)
exceptions.rationale: Package unmaintained; no patched version available (patched_versions: <0.0.0). Transitive dep via @solana/spl-token > @solana/buffer-layout-utils > bigint-buffer. The vulnerable toBigIntLE() function is not called directly by our code.
exceptions.mitigation: Risk accepted: DoS-only impact (CWE-120), no data exfiltration, and the function is only reachable with attacker-controlled buffer sizes in the Solana token layout path. Pinned @solana/kit to 5.4.0 to limit exposure surface.
